modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On April 22, 1977: Optical fiber is first used to carry live telephone traffic.
On April 22, 1970: The first Earth Day is celebrated.
On April 22, 1876: The first National League baseball game is played at the Jefferson Street Grounds in Philadelphia.
April 22 is observed as Earth Day (International observance) and its related observance: International Mother Earth Day.
On April 22, 1954: Red Scare: Witnesses begin testifying and live television coverage of the Army–McCarthy hearings begins.
